forbidden.name: not-to-node-builtins
forbidden.comment: Plugin code runs inside the opencode host (node), but accidental node builtin imports in shared libs should stay explicit.

forbidden.name: tui-read-only
forbidden.comment: src/tui is a read-only reader (progress-contract §2, §10): writer modules are forbidden. plan-io is allowed for readPlanFile (O_NOFOLLOW) and plan-fast-template for computeSourceSha256, as the contract requires.
